# usehooks-ts

> > A modern, tree-shakable TypeScript library of custom React hooks with full SSR support and type safety.

usehooks-ts provides production-ready React hooks built with TypeScript, offering utilities for event handling, window management, debouncing, and more. The library is lightweight, fully typed, and designed for modern React applications with server-side rendering compatibility.

## Key Topics

- React hooks
- TypeScript
- Custom hooks
- Tree-shakable
- Type-safe
- SSR support
- useEventCallback
- useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
- useWindowSize
- useDebounceCallback
- useEventListener
- Memoization
- Event handlers
- Open source

## Getting Started

- [usehooks-ts](https://usehooks-ts.com): TypeScript React hooks library homepage with features and documentation

## Hook Reference

- [useEventCallback](https://usehooks-ts.com/react-hook/use-event-callback): useEventCallback hook API reference for memoized event callbacks
- [useWindowSize](https://usehooks-ts.com/react-hook/use-window-size): useWindowSize hook API reference for tracking window dimensions
